mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, owner_user_id, watch_type, subject_kind, subject_id, threshold_band, threshold_days, threshold_level, status, cooldown_days, expires_on, last_evaluated_at, last_fired_at, last_fired_state, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_watch WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND status = 'active' AND (expires_on IS NULL OR expires_on >= #{today}) ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_watch (workspace_id, owner_user_id, watch_type, subject_kind, subject_id, threshold_band, threshold_days, threshold_level, status, cooldown_days, expires_on) VALUES (#{watch.workspaceId}, #{watch.ownerUserId}, #{watch.watchType}, #{watch.subjectKind}, #{watch.subjectId}, #{watch.thresholdBand}, #{watch.thresholdDays}, #{watch.thresholdLevel}, #{watch.status}, #{watch.cooldownDays}, #{watch.expiresOn})
